title: Streamlined Product Lifecycle Management with Linear
business: Product managers and engineering leads who need to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and granular task execution.
problem: Teams often suffer from context switching between strategy documents and project management tools, leading to stale project plans and misaligned engineering priorities.
solution: By integrating Linear directly into the ChatGPT interface, teams can synchronize PRD drafting with issue creation, ensuring that strategic updates automatically reflect in the project tracking system without manual data entry.
steps: Authenticate the Linear plugin within the ChatGPT interface to grant access to the specific workspace.
Draft a PRD or project update using natural language, prompting the model to summarize key deliverables.
Invoke the Linear plugin to convert identified action items into actionable issues linked to specific projects.
Update project status or issue priority directly through chat prompts to keep the team aligned on real-time progress.
outcome: Improved operational velocity and reduced administrative overhead by maintaining a single source of truth for both documentation and task management.
limitation: The plugin relies on the model's ability to accurately parse intent; complex updates involving multiple cross-project dependencies may require manual verification in the Linear UI to ensure correct field mapping.
